changeSet.sql: UPDATE court_schedule SET national_break_time = CASE WHEN session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London' != session_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' THEN (DATE_TRUNC('day', session_start_time) + INTERVAL '12:00:00')::timestamp with time zone ELSE (DATE_TRUNC('day', session_start_time) + INTERVAL '13:00:00')::timestamp with time zone END;
